scientific_integrity: The quartic's smoothness, exact five-line Fano scheme, four graph-lifting linear systems, and stabilizer scheme structure have exact characteristic-two algebraic certificates. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the polarization-preserving automorphism group scheme of the explicit q=2,b=1 companion quartic over the algebraic closure is determined; not the full abstract K3 automorphism group or all space-filling quartics. Unindexed literature remains a priority risk.
title: Geometric polarized rigidity of a smooth binary space-filling K3 quartic
